text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the south side of Fordhouse Boulevard, between Algie Avenue and a point 50 metres east. The proposed amendment will deter parking in this area, allowing access for heavy vehicles utilizing the parking/loading area at 60 Fordhouse Boulevard.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Fordhouse Boulevard, between Algie Avenue and a point 50 metres east.
